head: 겨울 타이어, 정확히 언제 갈아야 할까
prompt: Early winter morning in a Korean apartment complex parking lot, frost covering the asphalt and car windshields, thin mist visible from cold air. A Korean man in his 40s wearing a padded jacket crouches beside his car's front tire, breath visible in the cold, resting one gloved hand on the tire tread while looking down at it thoughtfully. Low morning sunlight casting long shadows across the parking lot, shallow depth of field focusing on the man and tire with blurred parked cars in the background, natural handheld phone-camera look, slightly desaturated cold color tone.
alt: 서리 낀 이른 겨울 아침 주차장에서 한 남성이 자동차 타이어 상태를 살펴보는 모습

head: 마모 한계선 3mm, 어떻게 확인하나요
prompt: Close-up but not extreme macro shot of a car tire tread groove at a slight low angle, taken outdoors in a residential parking lot with natural daylight. A Korean woman's hand, wearing a light glove, holds a 100-won coin sideways and inserts its edge into the tread groove to check depth, sunlight raking across the rubber texture to emphasize the grooves and slight wear. Background softly blurred showing pavement and a car's wheel well, realistic phone-photo grain, no visible numbers or gauge markings in frame.
alt: 동전을 타이어 홈에 넣어 마모 상태를 확인하는 손 클로즈업

head: 타이어 교체, 이렇게 준비하면 돼요
prompt: Inside a small Korean neighborhood tire repair shop, slightly cluttered and lived-in with tires stacked along the wall and fluorescent overhead lighting. A Korean man in his 30s wearing a work uniform and gloves kneels beside a car that is raised on a lift, using a pneumatic wrench to remove lug nuts from a wheel, sparks of motion blur on the spinning tool, a new winter tire leaning against the car nearby. Mid-shot angle from a few meters away, warm indoor lighting mixed with a shaft of daylight from the open shop entrance, candid documentary photo feel.
alt: 타이어 정비소에서 정비사가 차량 리프트 아래에서 타이어를 교체하는 모습
